nodes.name: anti-patterns.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive guide to Naive UI anti-patterns and their correct alternatives. Covers import patterns (global vs direct), component patterns (Options API vs Composition API, TypeScript usage), form patterns (ref usage, validation rules), data table patterns (row-key, custom render with h()), theme patterns (hardcode vs theme system), layout patterns (responsive grids), feedback patterns (message/notification vs console.log, loading states), performance patterns (virtual scroll for large data), error handling patterns (empty try-catch), and accessibility patterns (labels). Provides a summary table mapping each anti-pattern to its best practice.

nodes.name: best-practices.md
nodes.summary: Definitive best practices guide for Naive UI development. Covers import patterns (direct import recommended over global), component usage (Composition API with TypeScript), form handling (FormInst ref, FormRules with triggers, proper structure), data table setup (columns with h() render, row-key), theme customization (centralized GlobalThemeOverrides), layout structure (NLayout with sider), performance (virtual scroll, lazy loading with n-spin), icons (xicons integration), composition patterns (composable functions), accessibility (labels, keyboard navigation), and common patterns (confirmation dialogs, form submission with loading states). Lists anti-patterns to avoid at the end.

nodes.name: components.md
nodes.summary: Complete reference of Naive UI component categories and usage patterns. Documents data components (NDataTable, NTree, NTag, NBadge, NAvatar, NProgress, NStatistic), form components (NForm, NInput, NSelect, NCheckbox, NRadio, NSwitch, NSlider, NDatePicker, NUpload, NDynamicInput, etc.), layout components (NLayout, NGrid, NSpace, NCard, NDivider), navigation components (NMenu, NTabs, NBreadcrumb, NPagination, NDrawer, NModal), feedback components (NDialog, NMessage, NNotification, NAlert, NTooltip, NDropdown, NSpin), and typography components (NText, NP, NH1-NH6, NCode). Explains controlled vs uncontrolled patterns, slots usage, events with on- prefix, and virtual list support.

nodes.name: installation.md
nodes.summary: Installation and setup guide for Naive UI. Covers package installation via npm/pnpm/yarn, additional packages (@vicons/ionicons5 for icons, vfonts for fonts), four usage patterns (direct import recommended, global install not recommended, selective global install, auto import with unplugin-vue-components), TypeScript setup with Volar integration (tsconfig.json types, env.d.ts declarations), and Nuxt integration via official module or manual auto-import resolver. Emphasizes direct import for production tree-shaking.

nodes.name: theming.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive guide to Naive UI theming system. Covers theme architecture (hierarchical: common variables → component-specific → nested ConfigProvider), built-in themes (lightTheme, darkTheme), ConfigProvider usage with GlobalThemeOverrides, global theme customization (primaryColor, status colors, typography, border radius, spacing), component-specific overrides (Button, Card, Input, Select, DataTable), theme inheritance via nested ConfigProvider, dark mode toggle with reactive theme, performance optimization (inlineThemeDisabled for SSR, CSS variables for efficient updates).
